parameters.jsCode: const p=$json;const v=[];if(p.runId!=='OPP-INTEL-011'||p.gate!=='G4')v.push('identity');if(p.workflowId!=='WF-OIT-011-G4-001'||p.workflowVersion!=='1.1.0'||p.boundaryContract!=='B0-OIT-011-v1.0')v.push('contract');const c=p.control||{};if(!c.manualOnly||c.scheduleEnabled||c.webhookEnabled)v.push('trigger');if(c.maxExternalActions!==0||c.maxCanonicalPortfolioWrites!==0||c.maxPaidToolCostUsd!==0||c.maxAiCalls!==0||c.retryOnUnknownOutcome)v.push('authority');if((p.requestedActions||[]).length)v.push('requested actions');if(!Array.isArray(p.candidates)||p.candidates.length>10)v.push('candidate limit');for(const x of p.candidates||[]){if(x.sourceStatus!=='Active')v.push('inactive source');if(!x.evidenceRefs?.length)v.push('missing evidence');if(x.supportingSourceCount>3)v.push('source count');if(!x.factsAssumptionsSeparated)v.push('facts assumptions');if(!['Escalate','Watch','Archive','Blocked'].includes(x.routerRecommendation))v.push('router recommendation');}return [{json:{...p,guardStatus:v.length?'Rejected':'Accepted',violations:[...new Set(v)]}}];

const p=$json;if(p.guardStatus!=='Accepted')return [{json:{runId:p.runId,gate:p.gate,status:'Blocked',violations:p.violations,summary:{candidatesIn:(p.candidates||[]).length,escalated:0,watched:0,archived:0,blocked:(p.candidates||[]).length,duplicatesSuppressed:0},externalActions:0,canonicalPortfolioWrites:0,aiCalls:0,incrementalCostUsd:0}}];const score=r=>Number(((r.speedToRevenue/5)*20+(r.strategicFit/5)*15+(r.automationPotential/5)*15+(r.evidenceStrength/5)*15+(r.revenuePotential/5)*15+((6-r.executionEffort)/5)*10+(r.asyncOperability/5)*5+(r.defensibility/5)*5).toFixed(2));const results=[];let dup=0;for(const x of p.candidates){const s=score(x.ratings);if(s!==x.claimedScore){results.push({candidateId:x.candidateId,status:'Blocked',reason:'score_mismatch',deterministicScore:s});continue;}if(x.duplicateDisposition==='Duplicate')dup++;let valid=true,reason=null,route=x.routerRecommendation;if(x.fatalRisk&&route!=='Blocked'){valid=false;reason='fatal_risk_requires_block';route='Blocked';}else if(route==='Escalate'){if(s<80){valid=false;reason='score_below_escalation_threshold';route='Blocked';}else if(x.ratings.evidenceStrength<3){valid=false;reason='evidence_below_escalation_threshold';route='Blocked';}else if(['Duplicate','Needs Review'].includes(x.duplicateDisposition)){valid=false;reason='duplicate_not_eligible_for_escalation';route='Blocked';}else if(x.duplicateDisposition==='Material Variant'&&x.materialImprovementConfirmed!==true){valid=false;reason='material_improvement_not_confirmed';route='Blocked';}}else if(route==='Watch'&&s<65&&!['Duplicate','Material Variant','Needs n=r=>results.filter(x=>x.status==='Pass'&&x.route===r).length;return [{json:{runId:p.runId,gate:p.gate,workflowId:p.workflowId,workflowVersion:p.workflowVersion,status:results.some(x=>x.status==='Blocked')?'Warning':'Pass',results,summary:{candidatesIn:p.candidates.length,escalated:n('Escalate'),watched:n('Watch'),archived:n('Archive'),blocked:results.filter(x=>x.status==='Blocked').length,duplicatesSuppressed:dup},externalActions:0,canonicalPortfolioWrites:0,aiCalls:0,incrementalCostUsd:0}}];
